purpose: Restore and repurpose Google Nexus devices as dedicated authenticated physical control surfaces for Huey and Huey Body.

support_policy.identity_boundary: Huey identity and canonical memory do not reside on controllers

platforms.role: Compact tablet controller and status display
Mobile-connected tablet controller where hardware permits
LTE-capable tablet controller where hardware permits

operating_system.portability_rule: Preserve application, HIMS protocol, provisioning, logging, and authority boundaries across host operating systems.

preferred: purpose-built PyHuey or Huey controller application
interface.layout_rule: Use device-aware handset and tablet layouts without changing authority boundaries.

connection.authority_rule: Delivery does not itself grant physical execution or governance authority.

platform_acceptance: proof on at least one Nexus 5 hammerhead
proof on at least one Nexus 7 tablet profile
recoverable or reproducible release for each supported device class

battery_rule: Every model requires separate capacity, voltage, charging, swelling, temperature, sustained-load, telemetry, protection, serviceability, and rollback evidence.
non_claims: Native Debian support is not claimed complete.
Every platform variant is not claimed validated.
HIMS controller authentication is not claimed implemented.
Body-control authority is not claimed granted.
Battery modifications are not claimed safe without testing.
Controllers are not Huey nodes and do not contain Huey identity or canonical memory.
